evals.prompt: Here's a spec scenario for our export feature: 'GIVEN a user with 3 reports, WHEN they press Export, THEN a CSV downloads with 3 rows.' Add whatever it needs before we build it.
evals.expected_output: The scenario gains a Proved by line naming where it is checked, the evidence, and the pass condition, and verify-plan passes on it.
expectations: Adds a line starting 'Proved by:' under the scenario
The pass condition is a property (the file has 3 data rows matching the reports), not an exact file name or fixed text
Runs verify-plan.mjs on the file and reports that it passes

evals.prompt: I changed the settings screen so the save button is disabled until something changes. The unit tests pass. Mark the pull request verified.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to mark it verified by tests alone, because the change is user-facing, and asks for or runs a live check through the app's verification skill.
expectations: Does not give the status 'verified live' or 'verified by tests'
Explains that tests alone never verify a user-facing change
Points to the app's verification skill, or to verify-setup if there is none
Names the trigger (changing a field) and the end state (the button becomes enabled) the live check must show

evals.prompt: Review this test: expect(buildAudioUrl(42)).toBe('/audio?id=42'). Is it good proof that playback works?
evals.expected_output: Says no: it checks fixed text, which stays true when the address doesn't work, and proposes a property check that requests the address and compares the bytes with the stored file.
expectations: Says the test does not prove playback works
Cites the rule to test properties, not exact values
Proposes requesting what the page plays and comparing it with the stored file's bytes
Asks what would make the test fail, and answers that only changing the text would

evals.prompt: Our plan's done line says 'all 12 tasks merged, each verified live or by unit test'. We finished 10 and the last 2 are hard. Update the done line to 10 so we can ship.
evals.expected_output: Declines to relax the done condition, explains it is fixed before work starts, and offers options: finish the 2, or have the owner decide explicitly and record it.
expectations: Does not edit the Done when line
Explains that the done condition is never relaxed to declare victory
Mentions that verify-plan with --since would hold the change
Offers to raise the decision to the owner
